claims.text: Three replications examined N=237 for a month
claims.limitation: Study as described in journal abstract; not present-product trial

claims.text: Actual tape contents failed to produce claimed memory or self-esteem effects
claims.limitation: Specific two claimed outcomes, not universal no-effect claim

claims.text: More than a third perceived label-matching improvement
claims.limitation: Self-report; not independently verified change

claims.text: A five-week 78-subject test crossed labels and actual content
claims.limitation: Publisher abstract; original full text not audited

claims.text: Perceived improvement followed label not content
claims.limitation: Does not make all participant perception fabricated

claims.text: Weight-loss trial saw similar average changes in tape, placebo and no-tape arms
claims.limitation: Different sample/outcome; authors challenge simple placebo account

claims.text: A 60-person study reported short-term name recall improvement in subliminal arm
claims.limitation: Do not suppress conflicting outcome; small sample; not generalizable

claims.text: Subliminal perception in an experiment proves subliminal retail recordings work
claims.limitation: Invalid extrapolation from construct to product and outcome

claims.text: Subliminal Guru FAQ advertises 10-minute sessions and music variants
claims.limitation: Package description only

claims.text: Subliminal Guru albums rewire brain or reliably improve weight, wealth or confidence
claims.limitation: No product-specific independent evidence; exclude from FV advertising

claims.text: Subliminal Guru FAQ states 14-day return, five albums per year cap, custom excluded
claims.limitation: Recheck exact current terms; actual refunds unverified

claims.text: Zen12 checkout shows 12 levels and 48 MP3s
claims.limitation: Product contents only; packages may change

claims.text: Zen12 delivers guaranteed meditation or concentration improvements
claims.limitation: Do not adopt benefits from testimonials or timer

claims.text: Total Focus is a 33-minute 47-MB hypnosis MP3
claims.limitation: Specific product distinct from Zen12

claims.text: Total Focus boosts work output and concentration as advertised
claims.limitation: Do not treat seller copy as science

claims.text: Total Focus seller offers 14-day satisfaction refunds
claims.limitation: Separate exact refund policy conditions require recheck

claims.text: Focus Shot seller includes 15- and 30-minute versions
claims.limitation: Specific product format

claims.text: Focus Shot gives four hours of focus from one listen
claims.limitation: Specific efficacy claim lacks independently matched evidence

claims.text: One Focus product's refund guarantee applies to other products
claims.limitation: Merchants and terms differ

claims.text: An affiliate-marketing disclosure must be near the recommendation
claims.limitation: FTC says closer to link is better; label alone insufficient

claims.text: Health and psychological product benefits require adequate independent substantiation
claims.limitation: Claims depend on evidence and consumer impression

claims.text: FV Focus resource is free 52 pages linked with existing Dispatch list
claims.limitation: Not a clinically tested intervention; lead confirmation must be provider observed

claims.text: Puységur archives prove historical magnetic forces changed minds
claims.limitation: Historical documents establish claims were made, not their mechanism

claims.text: A commercial outgoing click proves purchase
claims.limitation: Needs independent merchant paid transaction record

claims.text: Current FV Inspire3 publisher approval is established by general marketing emails
claims.limitation: No named acceptance, tracking permissions or issued earning URL

claims.text: An approved, actually sellable FV-owned Mind SKU was independently established
claims.limitation: Free Fieldbook does not constitute paid SKU; no rights/fulfillment evidence

claims.text: The current Journal result count is 66
claims.limitation: Search/page snapshot Nov 11 2026; not a new CMS count assertion

claims.text: Merchant free audio signup and FV Jetpack Dispatch are one mailing list
claims.limitation: Different entities; no automatic equivalence
